observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down the choreography into structured sections, demonstrating movements step-by-step while explaining counts and directions. She is joined by an assistant to show full movement execution.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces the song and explains she will break it down into parts.
Breaks down the chorus into smaller moves step-by-step.
Teaches part A with directional footwork.
Teaches part B incorporating steps and arm movements.
Full demonstration to music with the assistant.

steps_taught.name: Part A Step
steps_taught.description: Facing diagonal and stepping side with arms.

steps_taught.name: Part B Step

what_works: Dividing the song into distinct labeled parts like chorus, A, and B
Showing the slow breakdown before dancing to music
what_hinders: Only teaching facing the front without back-view demonstrations
